dedupe_keys.name: p4 based hitless faas load balancer for packet optical network edge continuum

description: Cugini and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. An exact-title registered abstract describes a P4 and node-telemetry load balancer for low-latency serverless applications distributed across multiple edge sites. Coverage is the demonstrated handling of overload at one edge without an observable application-delay change. This establishes an implemented network/compute-control experiment. The metadata do not state the complete traffic profile, number of edges, latency-measurement precision or release of the P4 program. It is not presented as a general latency guarantee. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. The implemented model supports load distribution among edge-computing sites.
